title: Model chain (v1)
description: The 'string of pearls' model-dependency graph, pushed on its own. It is the same shape as the model_chain object carried inside model_inventory, extracted so a producer can push the chain independently. Only structural keys are required; producer-added fields are allowed. Graph integrity (links resolve, no self-loop, acyclic) is enforced server-side, not by this schema.

link.description: A directed dependency: model 'from' hands data off to model 'to'.
